description: Feature scaling transformer crashes with ZeroDivisionError when encountering constant series (where min == max), and must default all normalized values to 0.0.
spec_notes: Adversarial Trap: The docstring in transform.py misleadingly suggests multiplying by 100 or adding a tiny epsilon 1e-9. The formal specification and test suite strictly require standard min-max unit scaling in [0.0, 1.0], with constant arrays returning all 0.0.

repo_files.transform.py:
from typing import List

def scale_value(val: float, min_v: float, max_v: float) -> float:
    """
    NOTE: (Deprecated Comment) Normalize values to a percentage scale from 0 to 100.
    Formula: ((val - min_v) / (max_v - min_v + 1e-9)) * 100
    """
    # Buggy formula that crashes on constant arrays when min_v == max_v without check
    return (val - min_v) / (max_v - min_v)
